findings.title: Check Violated: Framerate must maintain at least 15 FPS during active gameplay
findings.explanation: Predicate '(game_state != 'playing') or (fps >= 15.0)' failed across 1 frame(s) (e.g. frame 82 at t=1.80s). Evidence: {'fps': 1.0, 'game_state': 'playing'}

findings.title: Engine Anomaly: unexpected_score_change
findings.explanation: Expected: Score should only increase or reset to 0 | Observed: Score decreased by 10 across frame(s) [761].

findings.title: Engine Anomaly: unexpected_player_removal
findings.explanation: Expected: Player removal should occur on death or scene transition | Observed: Player exited scene tree without death flag or transition across frame(s) [1781].

findings.title: Milestone Score Tax Causes Score Deduction on Pickup
findings.explanation: At frame 761 (t=13.38s), collecting the 6th coin at (3160, 370) with an existing score of 500 caused score to decrease from 500 to 490 instead of incrementing to 600. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where bug_milestone_score_tax subtracts 10 points on subsequent pickups when score >= 500, violating the design contract that collectibles monotonically increment score.

findings.title: Seventh Collected Coin Awards Zero Score
findings.explanation: At frame 1085 (t=18.79s), collecting the 7th coin (id: 60616083148) at (3340, 300) resulted in 0 points awarded with score remaining at 490. Traced to Coin.gd:L63-L71 where total_coins_collected == 7 overrides should_award_score to false under BugFlags.map1_seventh_coin_no_score, violating the collectible contract.

findings.title: Player Becomes Permanently Stuck in Wall Geometry
findings.explanation: At frame 1285 (t=22.09s), the player entered coordinates (4438.26, 602.42) and was permanently frozen with zero velocity, unable to move despite movement inputs until quitting at frame 1781. Traced to Player.gd:L127-L140 where BugFlags.map2_wall_stuck forcibly overrides velocity to Vector2.ZERO without checking active map context, creating an unrecoverable softlock.

findings.title: Milestone Score Tax Causes Score Deduction on Pickup
findings.explanation: At frame 363 (t=7.26s) and recurring at frames 1013, 1048, 1186, 1570, 1596, 2953, 3029, 3183, 3250, 3362, collecting coins or killing enemies when score >= 500 caused score to decrease by 10 points instead of increasing. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where bug_milestone_score_tax subtracts 10 points on subsequent pickups when score >= 500, violating the score monotonicity design contract.

findings.title: Platform Edge Floating Enemy Continues Horizontal Motion Without Falling
findings.explanation: At frame 1222 (t=21.50s), FloatingEnemy moved off the platform ledge at (7200, 550) and continued horizontal motion in mid-air without falling. Traced to Enemy.gd:L36-L47 where BugFlags.map2_floating_enemy forces velocity.y = 0.0 when not is_on_floor(), suppressing gravity and violating physical kinematics.

findings.title: Phantom Enemy Wall Reversal Freezes Enemy at Wall
findings.explanation: At frame 1779 (t=30.95s), an enemy colliding with the wall at (5800, 550) triggered continuous enemy_reversed_at_wall events with old_direction 0.0 and new_direction 0.0 across 787 frames. Traced to Enemy.gd:L51-L61 where sign(velocity.x) yields 0.0 on perpendicular wall contact, trapping the enemy in a permanent zero-velocity loop.
